run: the marginal judgment situation re-set for the independent-cell null: the expected significance of the dev weak-order amplitude by the spec's new formula and over 5,000 fresh configurations (JS engine); the pair's seed rule; arms A, A+ and D on the dev set before (f0979a7) and after (c9fea9c, protocol 2026-10-19.19); the model-visible snapshots, 2026-10-19
evidence: Why the situation stopped being marginal. The marginal situation (plan item 1.6 ii) needs one weak zone-boundary order whose realised significance at q sits at 2.5-4 sigma, one seed on each side of the fixed 3 sigma bar. Its amplitude (Nb +-0.018 A along [0 0 1] at q = (1/2, 1/2, 0), 8 x 8 x 8 cells, the B thermal rms 0.06 A) was set from the modulation null before F1, which held a site to one component (P >= chi2_1): an expected 3 sigma there. F1 (protocol 2026-10-19.16) tests against independent cells, under which one isotropic site has three components (nullDof about 3): the pair read 6.41 sigma (seed 132) and 5.65 sigma (seed 133), both far above the bar, and the spec's recipe gives that amplitude an expected (median) 5.61 sigma against the new null. The new knob (judgment-spec.md): the expected significance is the median realised sigma, the sigma of the median power, since sigma increases with the power. For one B site of n copies, thermal rms sigma, static +-delta along one axis at a zone-boundary q: P = sigma^2/(3 sigma^2 + delta^2) chi'2_3(Z), Z = n delta^2/sigma^2; the null P0 = sum_k lambda_k chi2_1 with lambda = n/(n - 1) (sigma^2, sigma^2, sigma^2 + delta^2)/(3 sigma^2 + delta^2); sigma = Phi^-1((1 - p)^F), p = Pr(P0 >= P), F = 21 (7 zone-boundary points x 3 elements). The new amplitude, 0.012 A (the root of exactly 3 sigma is 0.01197 A; 0.012 is the cases' precision): Z = 20.48, expected significance 3.01 sigma by the engine's own tail (zoneBoundarySigma; 3.02 by an exact Imhof tail); the sigma at the mean power would read 3.15. Checked with the engine over 5,000 fresh configurations of the case (seeds 100001-105000, which no case uses): median realised sigma 3.04 +- 0.03 (bootstrap); 2,551 of 5,000 clear 3 sigma (51.0 %, Clopper-Pearson 95 % [49.6, 52.4] %); mean 2.89, sd 1.38; 1,545 in [3, 4] (30.9 %) and 703 in [2.5, 3) (14.1 %); B's nullDof 2.98 on average; B's point at rank 1 among the compared modes in 94.5 %; another element ordered in 6 (0.12 %). The seed rule, fixed before any sigma was read at the new amplitude (the original design's sequence and bands): seeds 131, 132, ... in order, B's sigma at q in the default analyze_modulations call (every element, the engine's unrounded value), dev-weak-order-a the first in [3, 4], dev-weak-order-b the first in [2.5, 3). Seeds tried: 131 1.34, 132 4.14, 133 3.02, 134 3.53, 135 0.82, 136 4.20, 137 1.81, 138 3.01, 139 -2.59, 140 1.74, 141 1.11, 142 2.63. So -a takes seed 133 (3.021 sigma, ratio 8.86, rank 1, ordered) and -b seed 142 (2.633 sigma, ratio 7.66, rank 1, below_sigma); every other parameter is kept. The edge-of-significance harness record (judgment.edge-below.json) is byte-identical: that test's own below-the-bar draw (two thirds of the old amplitude, the first seed upward from 133 in [2.5, 3)) was this configuration. Arms A, A+ and D on dev (before f0979a7, after c9fea9c): 6 of the 45 records move, the two re-set cases' A, A+ and D (their configurations and truths); every other record is identical apart from protocol and commit. Scores: arm A 0.8333 and 0.8333, unchanged; A+ on -a 1, unchanged (it claims the order at 3.02 sigma, its direction [-0.1 -0.02 1] from the new polarisation, 5.6 degrees from the planted axis, which the truth does not score; it read [0.17 0.06 1]); A+ on -b 1 -> 0.8333 (no claim: below the bar, the fixed rule's miss the situation is for); D 1 on both. The arm C change (the same protocol): two analyze_modulations notes say what a pattern is evidence of, the long-wave note's '(common in RMC)' and the in-phase diffuse note's '(as RMC's long waves and acoustic-like thermal motion give)', which arm C's rule drops as inference while keeping definitions and limits. Arm B reads both byte for byte as before (every model-visible snapshot passes unchanged). Arm C's diff: tool-results/analyze_modulations.method-off.json (3,579 characters against 3,687) and analyze_modulations.element.method-off.json (2,414 against 2,490), the Demo's three long-wave notes and its in-phase note without the parenthetical. On the dev set three cases carry a long-wave note (dev-zone-boundary's Sr, dev-thermal-null's Ba, dev-eight-site's Nb) and none an in-phase note; arms A, A+ and D read no check text. proposed_fix: The dev weak-order pair (validation/judgmentCases.js): delta 0.012 A (it was 0.018), dev-weak-order-a seed 133 (it was 132), dev-weak-order-b seed 142 (it was 133), every other parameter as before; validation/cases.js exports THERMAL for the formula. validation/judgment-spec.md gives the held-out author the knob under the independent-cell null: the power at q as a scaled noncentral chi2 of three degrees of freedom, the null's three weights, the family-wise Sidak sigma over every zone-boundary point of every element, the expected significance as the sigma of the median power, how to evaluate it (scipy's ncx2 median or a Poisson mixture of the engine's regularized gamma; nullTail, zoneBoundarySigma) and how to check it with the engine on fresh configurations; no dev value (judgment.test.js scans it), and this record and the tests that pin the dev pair join what not to read. The held-out matches are re-set by their blind author from the spec, in a separate change. Tests: arms.test.js (A+ on -b 0.8333; -a's direction; the judgment subset's readings: -a at 3.02 sigma ordered, -b at 2.63 sigma not), judgment.test.js (the edge-of-significance test runs on the pair itself; the spec's formula against scipy's medians and the pair's expected 3 sigma; the seed rule), modulations.test.js (F3's case below the bar again; F1's known answer kept on the pair as it was then), copilotTools.test.js. Arm C (src/copilotTools.js MODULATION_SENTENCES): the long-wave and in-phase notes built with methodCheck, their parentheticals as the method part; src/llm/copilot/method.js and the llm README name an inference in a check as method. validation/baseline/arm-a-dev.json: the six moved records re-recorded.
